people.name: Thupten Jinpa Langri
people.field: religious studies and both Eastern and Western philosophy

relations.subject: Thupten Jinpa Langri
relations.place: Hunsur near Mysore, Karnataka, South India
relations.evidence: He received his early education and training as a monk at Zongkar Choede Monastery in Hunsur near Mysore, Karnataka, South India

relations.subject: Thupten Jinpa Langri
relations.object: Shartse College of Ganden monastic university
relations.evidence: later joined the Shartse College of Ganden monastic university, in Mundgod, Karnataka, South India, where he received the Geshe Lharam degree.

relations.subject: Thupten Jinpa Langri
relations.evidence: He taught Buddhist epistemology, metaphysics, Middle Way philosophy and Buddhist psychology at Ganden for five years.

relations.subject: Thupten Jinpa Langri
relations.role: B.A. Honors degree in Western Philosophy and a Ph.D. degree in Religious Studies
relations.evidence: Jinpa also holds a B.A. Honors degree in Western Philosophy and a Ph.D. degree in Religious Studies, both from Cambridge University, UK.

relations.subject: Thupten Jinpa Langri
relations.role: Margaret Smith Research Fellow in Eastern Religion
relations.evidence: From 1996 to 1999, he was the Margaret Smith Research Fellow in Eastern Religion at Girton College, Cambridge

relations.subject: Thupten Jinpa Langri
relations.evidence: he has now established the Institute of Tibetan Classics, where he is both president and editor-in-chief

relations.subject: Thupten Jinpa Langri
relations.role: visiting research scholar at the Stanford Institute for Neuro-Innovation and Translational Neurosciences
relations.evidence: He is a visiting research scholar at the Stanford Institute for Neuro-Innovation and Translational Neurosciences at Stanford University.

relations.subject: Thupten Jinpa Langri
relations.evidence: His latest works are Tibetan Songs of Spiritual Experience (co-edited with Jas Elsner)
